subject: communications.semantics.records

entries.definition: One bounded authority in which provider communication identities are meaningful, such as a workspace or mailbox.
A scope-bound venue or sequence that contains communication events without transferring provider lifecycle or effect authority to the base.
A provider actor or mail-address identity whose meaning is bounded to one communication scope and is not automatically a CRM identity.
Communication content treated as private data and never as instruction, policy, approval, or external-action authority.
An explicit relationship carrying an exact target Context subject and resource identity without changing either Context's authority.

limitations: This vocabulary defines provider-neutral communication meaning and grants no provider, persistence, approval, execution, readiness, verification, or health authority.
Concrete email and collaboration lifecycle rules belong to independently selectable specialization packs.
